statement: A quote binds the taker to nothing: it reserves only the maker's give, takes none of the taker's room and is no clause of the signed body, so a maker cannot lock the taker's funds or fill a proof body with clauses the taker never saw. At most 4 quotes per maker are open in an Account (too_many_quotes). The taker's first fill is its acceptance: the quote becomes an offer, a clause of its own, and the taker's want is reserved against the taker only if its RCPAN still holds (insufficient_capacity otherwise, the quote unchanged); a fill that takes everything never becomes a clause.
